en.headline: Disgusting Food Museum opens at AIRSIDE Kai Tak from 29 September
en.dek: Sweden’s travelling exhibition of more than 80 polarising dishes from 35 countries arrives at GATE33 Gallery, complete with local scents, a tasting bar and a vomit bag for every visitor.
body: Sweden’s Disgusting Food Museum will open at GATE33 Gallery on the third floor of AIRSIDE in Kai Tak on 29 September and run until 26 November, presenting more than 80 unusual and polarising foods from 35 countries.

The exhibition, which originated in Malmö and has previously visited Los Angeles, Berlin, Bordeaux and Taipei, features items such as Swedish surströmming, Icelandic fermented shark, Sardinian casu marzu cheese associated with live larvae, Peruvian frog juice and Rocky Mountain oysters. Local perfumers have created scent profiles for selected displays, and every visitor receives a vomit bag.

Five thematic zones explore why certain foods provoke disgust in one culture while remaining familiar in another. A tasting bar allows visitors, under staff guidance, to sample selected items including cricket snacks, Vegemite, sauerkraut juice, surströmming and fermented shark. Those who complete the challenge receive the title of Tastebud Warrior.

Opening hours are noon to 8 pm from Monday to Thursday and 11 am to 9 pm on Fridays, Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays. Adult tickets are priced at HK$68 on weekdays and HK$88 at weekends and holidays, with concessions and limited early-bird tickets available through Klook, Maoyan and UUTIX.

zh.headline: 嘔心食物博物館9月29日啟德AIRSIDE開幕
zh.dek: 瑞典巡迴展覽匯集逾80款來自35個國家的爭議美食，於啟德AIRSIDE GATE33 Gallery舉行，設本地氣味裝置、試食吧，每位入場者獲贈嘔吐袋。
body: 瑞典《嘔心食物博物館》將於9月29日至11月26日在啟德AIRSIDE三樓GATE33 Gallery舉行，展出逾80款來自35個國家的非常規及爭議美食。
展覽源自瑞典馬爾默，曾在洛杉磯、柏林、波爾多及台北等地展出。展品包括瑞典發酵鯡魚surströmming、冰島發酵鯊魚、撒丁島含活蛆的casu marzu芝士、秘魯青蛙汁及美國落磯山生蠔等。本地調香師為部分展品製作氣味，每位入場者均獲發嘔吐袋。
展覽分為五個主題區，探討為何某些食物在某一文化令人反感，在另一文化卻屬日常。試食吧在職員指導下提供蟋蟀零食、Vegemite、酸菜汁、發酵鯡魚及發酵鯊魚等試食，完成挑戰者可獲「味蕾勇者」稱號。
開放時間為星期一至四中午12時至晚上8時，星期五至日及公眾假期上午11時至晚上9時。成人票價平日68元、周末及假期88元，設優惠票及限量早鳥票，於Klook、貓眼及UUTIX發售。
